title: Heavenly Dao Puppet
next_chapter_hook: When Mo Xiansheng trembling spoke that name, Chen Ji felt the remnant soul on the first page of the Tianji Record shudder violently—so his master had such a connection to this fate-weaver from ten thousand years ago.

text.content: At the moment the shackles shattered, Chen Ji sensed a gaze that transcended Heavenly Dao's will—those eyes, older and colder than any existence he had ever witnessed. Yet now, as the film of fate obscuring his vision shattered completely, he finally saw the true source of that gaze.

That was no divine eye descending from heaven. As Chen Ji stepped into the core of the Heavenly Dao's Eye, the surrounding chaos receded like a tide, revealing a suffocating void. Countless light points floated like fireflies, each one an imprisoned fate—the final resting place of countless prophets, the shackles that countless reincarnators could not break free from.

And at the very center of the void, Chen Ji saw a massive puppet. This puppet was woven from countless threads of fate, each thread connected to a manipulated soul. Its form was vaguely indistinguishable—sometimes humanoid, sometimes like a great beast, sometimes like a deity, and sometimes just a writhing mass of black mist.

"So this is the Heavenly Dao's Eye?" Chen Ji's voice echoed in the void, tinged with sarcasm. "Nothing but a puppet wearing the guise of heavenly secrets." The puppet gave no response. But Chen Ji knew the truth ran far deeper—behind this puppet, someone must be pulling the strings.

dialogue.content: "It goes even further than that." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul materialized from Chen Ji's chest, his voice hoarse as withered leaves ground repeatedly by time. "This puppet indeed operates the authority of the Heavenly Dao's Eye, but it itself... is merely a tool for that Lord."

text.content: Chen Ji did not look back. He walked slowly toward the puppet's core, each step landing on those floating points of fate—when those points touched the edge of his robe, they turned to ash and dissipated. Countless prophets' entire lifetimes of fate lay light as dust beneath his feet.

"Mo Xiansheng." Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm. "That list from ten thousand years ago—you helped that Lord compile it, didn't you?" The remnant soul shuddered violently, but ultimately transformed into a bitter sigh.

dialogue.content: "...Yes." Mo Xiansheng's voice came from the depths of a dry well. "I owed him. I was once his disciple, and also... the one who betrayed him." Chen Ji finally stopped walking and turned around. Those eyes that always carried a hint of amusement were now cold as the ice at the bottom of an abyss.

text.content: "Betrayed?" Chen Ji softly repeated those two words, his tone betraying no emotional fluctuation. "So you stayed within the Tianji Record not because you were entrusted by your master, but because you had nowhere else to go—because that Lord would never permit a traitor who knew too much to remain among the living."

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul dimmed slightly. After a long silence, he finally spoke, his voice carrying a vulnerability Chen Ji had never heard before: "Junior Brother, do you know who that Lord is?" Chen Ji did not answer. He had already seen the answer—within the depths of the puppet's core, a vague silhouette was sleeping.

text.content: That silhouette was entwined by countless threads of fate, each thread connected to every limb of this puppet. It was the puppet's soul, the true hand that compiled that list ten thousand years ago. And that silhouette's outline... bore seven points of resemblance to Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul.

dialogue.content: "He is my Senior Brother." Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded emptied of something. "He is also Senior Brother Chen Xuan... the previous generation's candidate for succession." Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. The Tianji Record's legacy... had already begun selecting candidates ten thousand years ago?

text.content: "The Tianji Record chooses people, never looking at background, never considering aptitude, only examining one thing—whether one can bear the weight of fate." Mo Xiansheng's voice gradually steadied, returning to that mysterious and unpredictable tone. "Ten thousand years ago, Senior Brother lost to Chen Xuan; unwilling to accept this, he walked another path."

Chen Ji continued: "He refused to remain a chess piece, so he became the one who plays the game." Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment, then nodded. "He refined himself into part of the Heavenly Dao, taking the puppet's form to grasp heavenly secrets, compiling the list from ten thousand years ago, selecting the 'Chosen Ones' of each era—including your master Chen Xuan, and also... you."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly smiled. That smile was light and faint, yet it made Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul instinctively step back half a pace—in all the years he had followed Chen Ji, he had never seen this young man wear such an expression. It was neither mockery nor fury, but rather... bone-deep coldness.

text.content: "So from the very beginning, I was his chess piece." Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm. "The Tianji Record's legacy, Chen Xuan's fall, my 'waste' persona... all of it was his chess game. Did he foresee ten thousand years ago that I would stand here?"

dialogue.content: "Not foresight." Mo Xiansheng shook his head, his voice carrying a hint of bitterness. "It was arrangement. He cannot foresee the future, but he can... shape it. As long as enough chess pieces are placed in the correct positions, the ending will naturally unfold according to his script." Chen Ji slowly turned, facing that sleeping puppet.

choice.prompt: Facing this fate-weaver from ten thousand years ago, Chen Ji needed to make a choice. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul was awaiting his decision.

choices.description: Now that we know who the true enemy is, there's no need to keep playing along with it. Directly destroy the puppet's core and force that Lord to reveal himself.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes a large amount of Heavenly Fate Value; may awaken the sleeping enemy
choices.visible_reward: Completely shatter the ten-thousand-year arrangement and force out the true body
choices.risk_hint: He has been building his foundation for ten thousand years—who knows what backup plans he has?

text.content: Chen Ji's palm pressed against the puppet's core, and the power of the Tianji Record surged in like a tide. Those threads of fate wrapped around the core began snapping one by one, emitting ear-piercing shrieks. The puppet trembled violently, and countless light points burst from its body—those were the imprisoned fates of ten thousand years finally finding release.

choices.text: Strategic Maneuvering—Don't alarm the enemy; secretly gather intelligence
choices.description: A ten-thousand-year arrangement must have deep foundations. Acting rashly now would only alert the enemy. Better to take a step back and secretly investigate this Lord's true weaknesses.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve strength; find the enemy's weakness before delivering a lethal strike
choices.risk_hint: The enemy may already be watching your every move in the shadows

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his palm, and the killing intent in his eyes gradually faded. He began to re-examine this puppet with the eyes of a chess player—its structure, its method of operation, its weaknesses... He believed any existence has flaws, even an ancient giant who controls heavenly secrets.

choices.text: Question Mo Xiansheng—Force him to reveal more truth
choices.description: Mo Xiansheng has concealed too much. As a former fellow disciple, he must know that Lord's true background. Instead of guessing blindly here, it would be better to interrogate directly.
choices.visible_cost: May create a rift with Mo Xiansheng
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key intelligence; understand the enemy's true purpose
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng has his own calculations; what he says may not all be true

text.content: Chen Ji did not act hastily. He turned around, his gaze falling on Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul like a blade. "Mo Xiansheng, you've followed me this long; it's time to come clean. That Lord... what is his purpose? Why did he compile that list?"

The puppet let out a low rumble. Those broken threads of fate were reconnecting, thicker and more complex than before. The sleeper was being awakened. Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly became urgent: "This is bad! He sensed your presence—Junior Brother, you must make a choice immediately!"

At that moment, deep within the puppet's core, that sleeping figure slowly opened its eyes. Those were eyes utterly different from any existence Chen Ji had ever seen—no pupils, only endless runes rotating, each rune like an imprisoned fate. His gaze fell upon Chen Ji, as if looking at an ant that had finally fallen into his web. "Another chess piece that doesn't know its place," that voice rang directly in Chen Ji's mind, ancient and majestic. "Though, to reach this point, you are somewhat more impressive than I anticipated."

dialogue.content: Hearing this, the corner of Chen Ji's mouth instead lifted into a cold smile. He raised his head, staring directly into those rune-eyes, word by word: "Chess piece?" "Then let me ask you—Chess Player, where is your own chessboard?"

text.content: The rune-eyes narrowed slightly. That sleeping figure seemed to truly examine this ant before him for the first time. After a moment, he let out a low laugh. "Interesting. In ten thousand years, you are the first to dare speak to me like this." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled violently behind Chen Ji. Chen Ji knew—the true confrontation was just beginning.
